test_title: PYST 55: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have spelling errors. Choose the sentence with all correctly spelt words.

options.text: Their skilled colleague soon satisfied them that they were wrong.
It was a letter that was shot throught with the writer’s personality.
There is plenty of student accomodation in Edinburgh.
He advised the government not to persue a gas deal with that company.

solution:
The correct answer is option no.(1) i.e.** 'Their skilled colleague soon satisfied them that they were wrong'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence** 'Their skilled colleague soon satisfied them that they were wrong' **has no spelling errors all the words are correct and correctly spelt.

Therefore, the correct answer is option no.**(1) ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word from the option no.2 'throught' is wrong.
 
 
• C orrect spelling is** 'Through'.**
 
 
 
• The word from the option no.3 'accomodation' is wrong.
 
 
• Correct spelling is **'Accommodation'.**
 
 
 
• The word from the option no.4 'persue' is wrong.
 
 
• Correct spelling is **'Pursue'.**
